name: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of a diverse range of electronic components. The company produces various types of filters, including ceramic dielectric, dielectric waveguide, special, and LC filters, in addition to dielectric resonators, cavity filters, antennas, and duplexers. These essential components serve a broad spectrum of applications across civil, military, and various other industrial sectors. Established in 2004, Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Jiangsu, China.
